xfail: arris 0.10.0 refuses the third cut, OpDegenerateError "degenerate result: the faces touch along a curve interior to both result faces", of three slots 60 degrees apart that cross on the cylinder's axis; CadQuery 2.3.0 builds it (two slots build)
note: a cylinder of radius 4 and height 10, cut by three boxes 9 x 1 x 6 on its axis at 0, 60 and 120 degrees, each slot open through the side. With a = 1/2 and rho = 4, one slot strip meets the disc in S = 2 a sqrt(rho^2 - a^2) + 2 rho^2 asin(a/rho); two strips 60 degrees apart meet in a rhombus 8 a^2 / sqrt(3), and the three in a regular hexagon 2 sqrt(3) a^2, so the slots cover U = 3 S - 3 (8 a^2 / sqrt(3)) + 2 sqrt(3) a^2. V = pi rho^2 10 - 6 U. A = 2 pi rho^2 (the ends) + 2 U (the slots' ceiling and floor) + (2 pi rho 10 - 6 rho 12 asin(a/rho)) (the side less six openings of angle 2 asin(a/rho)) + 6 P (the slots' walls: twelve sides of sqrt(rho^2 - a^2) - sqrt(3) a, six high). Six wedge columns join the two end plates: genus 5
